project_goal: Create a formal, resumable alpha engineering workflow for the first official WorldQuant alpha cycle.

features.title: Create the first official research queue
features.description: Build the first formal queue of research directions for the initial alpha cycle.
acceptance_criteria: A real queue JSON exists under runs/research-queues.
The queue is compatible with the local research_queue_builder script.
The queue contains at least two distinct directions.

features.title: Create the primary field-search pack
features.description: Create a field-search pack for the primary research direction with search terms, candidate fields, and likely failure modes.
acceptance_criteria: A markdown field-search pack exists under runs/field-search-packs.
The pack lists search terms, candidate fields, and a baseline expression plan.
The pack clearly separates confirmed facts from hypotheses.

features.title: Draft the primary expression family
features.description: Create a baseline plus same-family expression variants for the primary direction.
acceptance_criteria: A markdown expression family file exists under runs/expression-families.
The file includes one baseline and at least three variants.
Each variant has a stated purpose or bottleneck target.

features.title: Capture the first real simulation results
features.description: Record real platform metrics and notes for the primary baseline and variants.
acceptance_criteria: A simulation capture JSON exists under runs/simulation-captures.
The capture includes real metrics from the platform.
Evidence artifacts exist for the capture.

features.title: Build the first formal candidate batch
features.description: Convert real simulation results into a candidate batch that can be triaged into submit, polish, branch, or kill.
acceptance_criteria: A candidate batch JSON exists under runs/candidate-batches.
The candidate batch is compatible with the local candidate_scorecard script.
The batch contains real metrics only.

features.title: Write the first formal daily note
features.description: Record the first official alpha-cycle session in the daily note format.
acceptance_criteria: A daily note JSON exists under runs/notes/daily.
The JSON is compatible with the local session_note_scaffold daily mode.
The note references real work from the current cycle.

features.title: Prepare the first submission memo
features.description: Write a submission memo grounded in real platform results and official checks.
acceptance_criteria: A submission memo markdown file exists under runs/submission-memos.
The memo references real simulation and test results.
The memo does not claim readiness without official platform evidence.
